researcher_corrections_pre_freeze.train_population: complete frozen eligible Known TRAIN pool, 6 classes x 25000 = 150000 rows per (rotation, seed); replaces infeasible 200000 target

scientific_questions.A_OSR_ADEQUACY: is the dedicated neural OSR sufficiently credible to judge Evidence? FAIL -> GATE_INVALID_OSR_INADEQUATE, Evidence may NOT be declared failed
scientific_questions.B_EVIDENCE_INFORMATION_POTENTIAL: offline oracle mechanism analysis: can at least one legal T/R/TR Evidence state recover frozen Recoverable Known in open-set representation space?
scientific_questions.C_EVIDENCE_SPECIFICITY: does Evidence move Recoverable Known toward Known regions more than it moves True Unknown toward Known regions?
scientific_questions.D_DEPLOYABLE_VALUE: with the exact frozen P6 Utility Typed router, does selective Evidence improve open-world performance relative to the SAME strong OSR using Basic only?

frozen_inputs.eval_parquet: open_world_recoverability_gate_v1/owg_v1_seed_<s>_rotation_<r>_eval.parquet (56000 rows; split_role 0=CALIB 1=EVAL; stored per-policy action/score/pred/rejected for P0/P1/P3/P4/P5/P6/P7)
frozen_inputs.gate1_root: core_gate_v1/ (core_gate_basic_features_v1.parquet 47 basic fields; gate_seed_<s>_history.parquet 34 history fields; gate_seed_<s>_targets.parquet)
frozen_inputs.recoverable_definition: frozen V1: Basic prediction wrong AND at least one legal Evidence state among BT/BR/BTR predicts correctly (stored recoverable column authoritative; no recomputation may replace it)
frozen_inputs.residual_hard_definition: Basic wrong AND BT wrong AND BR wrong AND BTR wrong (stored residual_hard column)

populations.TRAIN_POOL: partition_code==0 AND canonical_label in rotation known classes; 6 x 25000 = 150000 rows per cell; complete population, no sampling
populations.TRAIN_SPLIT_RULE: within each class, order activity groups by SHA256(seed_hex || rotation_utf8 || group_digest_bytes) ascending; assign a group to EARLY_STOP while the class cumulative EARLY_STOP row count (before the group) < round(0.10 * class_total); all remaining rows to FIT; no group crosses roles; no RNG
populations.VAL_CALIB_KNOWN: split_role==0 AND is_unknown==0 in the frozen eval parquet (calibration)
populations.VAL_GATE_EVAL: split_role==1 (outer True Unknown exposed ONLY for final evaluation metrics)
populations.true_unknown_exclusion: no True Unknown in representation training, normalization, early stopping, prototype/covariance fitting, threshold calibration, model/hyperparameter selection

encoder.fusion: [z_B, mT*z_T, mR*z_R, mT, mR] -> Linear(386,256) -> LayerNorm -> GELU -> Dropout(0.10) -> Linear(256,128)
encoder.shared_parameters: one encoder handles B/BT/BR/BTR; training exposes all four legal states (uniform state sampling per row per epoch, deterministic)
encoder.loss: CrossEntropy + 0.10 * SupervisedContrastiveLoss (temperature 0.10, batch contrastive, labels=Known class)
encoder.early_stopping: Known-only, patience=3, monitor validation CrossEntropy on OSR_TRAIN_EARLY_STOP

osr.class_means: per class, per Evidence state, fitted on OSR_TRAIN_FIT Known embeddings of that state
osr.covariance: ONE tied pooled LedoitWolf covariance shared by all classes, fitted per Evidence state on OSR_TRAIN_FIT Known embeddings
osr.primary_score: minimum Mahalanobis distance to any Known class mean; higher = more novel
osr.diagnostic_deep_msp: 1 - max softmax of the same encoder Known head on the relevant Evidence state; fixed diagnostic, never selected over Mahalanobis after results
osr.historical_baseline: frozen RF Basic MSP (stored P0 scores/preds from the frozen eval parquet; read-only)

calibration.target: 5% Known false-Unknown rate (95th percentile of Known post-policy scores)

frozen_p6.name: P6_UTILITY_TYPED
frozen_p6.order: max utility descending, tie ascending target order
frozen_p6.ideal_family: argmax, tie-break priority T, R, TR
frozen_p6.fallback: cheapest affordable family with positive predicted utility in priority order T then R, else NONE
frozen_p6.budget: 0.15 * N_targets, applied separately to calibration and evaluation populations
frozen_p6.recompute_cross_verify: deterministic recomputation from frozen selectors/models, cross-verified against stored action/score/pred columns BEFORE any metric

osr_adequacy.pass_iff: A1 AND A2 AND A3 AND A4
osr_adequacy.fail_decision: GATE_INVALID_OSR_INADEQUATE; Evidence may NOT be declared failed

evidence_information_potential.geometry: per legal state s: d_true(s)=Mahalanobis distance to true class mean; d_near_wrong(s)=min distance to any OTHER Known class mean; geometry_margin(s)=d_near_wrong(s)-d_true(s)
evidence_information_potential.best_legal_oracle: argmax over {BT,BR,BTR} of geometry_margin(s); GT-guided; NEVER a deployable policy
evidence_information_potential.standardization: per cell by Basic-state margin SD over the 150000-row TRAIN pool

evidence_specificity.knowness: minimum Mahalanobis distance to any Known class (lower = more Known-ward)
evidence_specificity.true_unknown_gain: max over {BT,BR,BTR} (most Known-ward legal state; conservative stress test)
evidence_specificity.C1: pooled mean gap > 0, paired group/temporal-block bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
evidence_specificity.C3_ratio_bound: pooled mean TU most-Known-ward gain <= 0.50 x pooled mean RK best-legal gain (applies only when RK gain > 0)
evidence_specificity.pass_iff: C1 AND C2 AND C3 AND C4

deployable_comparison.D2_furk_ci: pooled paired bootstrap 95% CI upper bound of (FURK(D1)-FURK(D0)) < 0
deployable_comparison.pass_iff: D1 AND D2 AND D3 AND D4

decision_matrix.GO: adequacy PASS + potential PASS + specificity PASS + deployable PASS
decision_matrix.GO_SIGNAL_EXISTS_ROUTER_LIMITED: adequacy PASS + potential PASS + specificity PASS + deployable FAIL + material frozen-router headroom (frozen P6 Evidence Recovery Rate <= 0.85 in >= 2/3 rotations from stored predictions)
decision_matrix.GATE_INVALID_OSR_INADEQUATE: adequacy FAIL; Evidence may NOT be declared failed
decision_matrix.NO_GO_CURRENT_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT: adequacy PASS AND (potential FAIL OR specificity FAIL) AND safeguards do not contradict; requires substantially more evidence than failure of the primary detector alone
decision_matrix.METHOD_DEPENDENT_REVIEW: all remaining combinations and every safeguard contradiction

conditional_no_go_safeguards.trigger: ONLY if OSR_ADEQUACY=PASS and the primary result would otherwise justify NO_GO_CURRENT_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT
conditional_no_go_safeguards.safeguard_A: raw normalized concat encoding (concat Basic/Temporal/Relation raw features + mask indicators, per-block standardization fitted on TRAIN Known only, same MLP recipe and training config), central seed 20260817 only, all three rotations

safeguard_B.name: DIRICHLET_EVIDENTIAL_EDL_CONFIRMATION
safeguard_B.scope: central seed 20260817 only, all three rotations
safeguard_B.trunk: identical typed-block masked-fusion encoders and fusion
safeguard_B.head: Dirichlet head: evidence e = softplus(Linear(128,6)) + 1; alpha = e (>= 1 by construction)
safeguard_B.loss: Type II Maximum Likelihood L = sum_k y_k (psi(S) - psi(alpha_k)), S = sum_k alpha_k; plus FIXED KL term to uniform Dirichlet, constant lambda = 0.1, no annealing, alpha_tilde = y + (1-y)*alpha
safeguard_B.early_stopping: Known-only patience=3 on the same EARLY_STOP slice (validation EDL loss)
safeguard_B.training_data: same TRAIN rule as primary; Known-only; True Unknown never in fitting or calibration
safeguard_B.score: 1 - max_k(alpha_k/S) (top-class belief mass; higher = more novel); S recorded descriptively
safeguard_B.analyses: re-evaluate Questions B and C: margin gain -> belief gain (belief(state)-belief(Basic)); true-class Mahalanobis distance -> true-class belief; same thresholds as sections 8/9
sanity_tests: training loss decreases over a few synthetic steps
belief score separates synthetic inliers from outliers
no Unknown row in fit set
safeguard_B.sanity_fail_status: CONFIRMATORY_EDL_STATUS=IMPLEMENTATION_INVALID (safeguard skipped, does not block the gate; NO-GO decision then rests on safeguard A and primary analyses)

conditional_no_go_safeguards.scope_of_safeguards: re-evaluate ONLY Questions B and C offline analyses; NOT a method-picking pool
conditional_no_go_safeguards.contradiction_rule: a materially contradictory strong positive on the failed criterion (safeguard's own PASS criteria met) -> METHOD_DEPENDENT_REVIEW instead of NO-GO

claim_boundary.gate_scope: determines whether the CURRENT strict-past T/R Evidence contract has sufficient open-world recoverability value to justify expensive Model-B development
claim_boundary.no_go_meaning: a project research decision, NOT a mathematical proof that no possible model could ever use Evidence
claim_boundary.invalid_meaning: says nothing about Evidence; only that the chosen OSR is not adequate to judge it

execution_lock.after_first_formal_metric: only pure implementation bugfixes with unchanged scientific semantics, logged; scientific change -> STOP_NEEDS_REVIEW

runner_contract.trainsplit_cross_check: reproduce recorded per-cell counts BEFORE training; mismatch -> STOP_NEEDS_REVIEW

git_policy.after_evaluation: DO NOT COMMIT result reports; DO NOT PUSH; leave for researcher review
